# Josh Wright

> Josh Wright is an AI engineer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at Arizona State University in May 2027. He builds AI systems: motion tracking models and animation plugins at Pixel Pirate Studio, FIREFIGHTER, an open-source scheduler that lets AI coding agents share one computer, and games, including Trust No One, which placed #9 of 2,253 entries in the Brackeys Game Jam.

Looking for: New grad software engineering roles starting May 2027, especially machine learning, computer vision, graphics, animation tools, gameplay and R&D at animation studios.
Contact: joshwright0322@gmail.com
